verification.context: English-language Disney character naming; original theatrical feature where a film is named. In Hercules (1997), which group acts as the musical Greek chorus telling Hercules's story?

premise.reason: The Muses function as the musical Greek chorus; the film also has an opening spoken narrator.

sources.locator: Opening film-history paragraph describes the Muses as the traditional Greek chorus using gospel music.
Second synopsis paragraph explicitly identifies Pain and Panic as Hades’ two sidekicks; cast separately credits Charlton Heston as opening narrator.
